bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/seigo-gace--gace-dev-kb
test -d "$root"
cd "$root"
printf 'SCRATCH_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
git status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true
for f in scripts/learning_asset_contract.py tests/test_learning_asset_contract.py docs/SCRATCH_FORMAL_PATCH_PROPOSAL.md; do if test -f "$f"; then sha256sum "$f"; else printf 'MISSING %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
if test -d /mnt/f/G-ACE-KB/repo; then
  printf 'FORMAL_REPO\n'
  git -C /mnt/f/G-ACE-KB/repo rev-parse HEAD
  git -C /mnt/f/G-ACE-KB/repo status --short --branch
  for f in scripts/learning_asset_contract.py tests/test_learning_asset_contract.py; do if test -f "/mnt/f/G-ACE-KB/repo/$f"; then sha256sum "/mnt/f/G-ACE-KB/repo/$f"; fi; done
fi
printf 'COMPOSER_CLI\n'
for c in cursor-agent agent cursor composer; do command -v "$c" || true; done
printf 'DATASET_CANDIDATES\n'
for d in "$root" /mnt/f/G-ACE-KB /mnt/c/Users; do if test -d "$d"; then find "$d" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name 'debugai_dataset_audited_v0_3*.zip' -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 10; fi; done
printf 'SOURCE_REVIEW\n'
for f in scripts/learning_asset_contract.py tests/test_learning_asset_contract.py docs/SCRATCH_FORMAL_PATCH_PROPOSAL.md; do if test -f "$f"; then printf '\n--- %s ---\n' "$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done
